why: The answer says name.toUpperCase() changes name, but that rule is wrong in Java: Strings are immutable, so toUpperCase returns a new String that is thrown away here, and the program prints "java", not "JAVA".

concepts.why: It treats the String as text that can be changed in place, but no operation changes an existing String.
It thinks a value-returning call changes the variable it is called on; in fact the returned value has to be stored or used.
